selector-class-pattern.message: Class selectors are camelCase, so a component reads them back as styles.thisName rather than through a bracketed string

property-disallowed-list.message: Inline-axis geometry is logical, so one stylesheet serves both reading directions: use inset-inline-start, margin-inline-end, padding-inline or border-inline-end

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: An inline-axis value follows the document rather than the page: use text-align: start, float: inline-start or clear: inline-end
